about: Proposed region definition for a detailed map of the island of Ireland (the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland) as one region. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-IE.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship.

codes.proposal: No code chosen: the scheme the maintainers pick for countries (IE, or eu-ie as in PR #84). Name: Ireland and Northern Ireland.
codes.why: A bare IE collides with no US code in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py).
codes.caveat: IE is the ISO 3166-1 code of the Republic only; Northern Ireland is GB-NIR (general knowledge, not checked against the ISO site).
codes.pr_84: PR #84's eu-ie uses the same extract, titled Ireland, boxed by Geofabrik's polygon; its eu-gb uses the united-kingdom extract, which also covers Northern Ireland.

republic.dataset: Tailte Éireann, National Statutory Boundaries - Counties Ungeneralised - 2026
republic.method: Vertex extent of all 9,261 polygons (2,030,853 vertices) fetched with outSR=4326. The service's returnExtentOnly answer is the reprojected corners of its Irish Transverse Mercator envelope and is not used.

northern_ireland.dataset: ONS Countries December 2023 Boundaries UK BFC, Northern Ireland row
northern_ireland.method: Vertex extent of the Northern Ireland polygon (206,626 vertices), used only to compute the east edge because OSNI's service did not resolve.

upper_bound.dataset: Geofabrik ireland-and-northern-ireland.poly (extract clipping polygon, 10 distinct vertices)
upper_bound.caveat: A coarse hull, far larger than the island. The extract's clipping shape, not a box for cutting map layers.

box_source.great_britain_inside_box: Scotland: south Kintyre with Campbeltown, Machrihanish and Sanda; west Arran; south tip of Islay. Wales: St David's Head, Ramsey Island, Grassholm, most of Skomer. None is inside the Irish extract, so they hold only base-map detail unless the United Kingdom extract is added. The Isle of Man and the Rhins of Galloway are outside.

crops.proposal: OSM landuse=orchard (746 objects, taginfo 2026-11-16), or no crop layer.

candidates.dataset: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints (dataset-links.csv 2026-08-13: Ireland 56 tiles, UnitedKingdom 194 tiles)
candidates.note: The UnitedKingdom rows include tiles over Belfast and County Down that the Ireland rows lack, so Northern Ireland's footprints are filed under the United Kingdom (tile contents not opened).

candidates.dataset: OSM buildings (4,091,466 objects tagged building, taginfo)

buildings.gap: No open official building outlines found for either jurisdiction (search only).

addresses.dataset: OSM addr:* tags and OSM townlands
addresses.gap: No other open source: Overture's address theme lists 41 countries; neither IE nor GB is among them. The Eircode database is licensed by agreement only. OSNI Pointer appears to be a paid licence (search only). Code-Point Open covers Great Britain; Northern Ireland is only in the paid Code-Point. ONS: BT postcodes need a separate licence for commercial use from Land and Property Services.

osm.source: taginfo, data until 2026-11-16; townland tagging per OSM wiki Ireland/Boundaries
osm.coverage_estimate: Very roughly one home in six, against about 2.9 million homes (general knowledge, not checked). An estimate, not a measurement; where the numbered addresses lie was not measured.

addresses.format: Republic: Eircode, 7 characters, routing key plus unique identifier (A65 F4E2). Northern Ireland: UK postcodes starting BT (general knowledge).
addresses.code_note: tools/build_addresses.py keeps only country = 'US', cuts the region to two letters and keeps left(postcode, 5) (A65 F4E2 becomes A65 F). engine/address_search.py reads only five-digit postcodes, and normalize() turns letters outside a-z (á, é, í, ó, ú) into spaces. The place finder holds US ZIP code areas only.
addresses.proposal: 1. Townlands with their county in the place finder. 2. An address index from OSM addr:* tags, saying plainly that coverage is partial. Or ship the map first without address search.

related.pr_84: Lists eu-ie from the same extract, boxed by Geofabrik's polygon; its eu-gb also covers Northern Ireland.
related.pr_35: Adds a Dublin box cut from the same extract.
related.pr_63: Reads the full .osm.pbf; its bus-shelter filter and any new help-point kinds need a reader like it.

help_points_builder_note: tools/build_map.py takes the class from the fclass column of Geofabrik's free GeoPackage, which has no class for defibrillators, ambulance stations or holy wells and no shelter_type (layer specification 0.7.12). man_made=water_well has a class but is not in POI_KEEP.
